headline: Paraguay's Central Bank Returns Deposits Amid Ueno Bank Crisis
summary: Paraguay's Central Bank has begun returning deposits to nearly 1.2 million users following the closure of Ueno Bank. S&P warns that the crisis and presidential transition could affect short-term investor confidence and delay fiscal correction.
why: Central bank interventions during bank closures aim to protect depositors and maintain financial stability. S&P monitors sovereign credit risks and economic stability in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Banking crises and delayed fiscal corrections weigh on the domestic economy and investor sentiment.
